mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 3.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 3.8%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% from prior month signal broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >0.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate output and earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO falls below 103.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 302.0 indicates persistent inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 302.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) falling below 100,000 signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending momentum, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS is below 100,000, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase (>0.2pp) and retail sales decline (>0.5%) signal dual stress on labor and consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and RSAFS declines > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.2pp and RSAFS declines >0.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 105.0 signals robust manufacturing expansion that boosts corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.
